messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have a function that can search for “pet‑friendly train stations.” The only tool available to me is `find_hotel`, which looks up hotels based on location, price, and pet policy.

If you’re looking for a place in Miami where you can bring a pet while traveling by train, the best option is to check the **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)**, which serves Amtrak, Brightline, and local transit. While the station itself doesn’t have a “pet‑friendly” designation, most of the trains that depart from there allow pets (usually small dogs in carriers) as long as you follow the carrier rules and keep your pet under control. 

If you need a pet‑friendly hotel near the station, I can use the `find_hotel` function to locate one that meets your budget and pet requirements. Just let me know the price range and any other preferences!
